name: 07823 · Belvidere, NJ
findings: ZIP 07823 (Belvidere) has 43 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (47% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07823 (Belvidere) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
